articles.title: Serena Williams belts out heartbreak anthems during solo karaoke session
articles.summary: Serena Williams traded her tennis racket for a microphone during a solo karaoke night, taking over a dark room as she sang Paula Abdul’s classic hit “Rush Rush.” The tennis legend shared the moment with her followers and made sure to warn anyone ready to judge her vocals that she is a tennis player, not a singer. But the performance came with a nostalgic story, as Serena revealed that she used to sing the song with all her heart back in fourth grade for her first crush, a boy named Ruben, who had absolutely no idea she had feelings for him. Looking back, she even questioned why she was singing such intense love lyrics at that age and dedicating them to a boy who didn’t even know what was going on. Fans couldn’t resist joking that she might be better off sticking to tennis after hearing her miss a few notes, but Serena seemed perfectly happy enjoying her solo karaoke session, bringing back childhood memories of innocent crushes and dramatic heartbreak anthems.
